item.title: The EBA publishes consumer factsheet on white-labelled financial products and services
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a factsheet to help consumers identify when a banking or payment product or service is white labelled, i.e. marketed under one brand but provided by another company. As consumers increasingly access financial products and services through online platforms, retailers and other non-financial brands, it may be sometimes unclear which company is responsible for providing the product or service. Understanding this distinction can help consumers make informed decisions, know who they are dealing with… — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact marché.

item.title: The EBA streamlines the 2027 EU-wide stress test with more than 55% reduction in requested data
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today released the final methodology, draft templates, and template guidance for its 2027 EU-wide stress test, together with the key milestones for the exercise. Following extensive engagement with industry participants, the EBA has significantly streamlined the exercise, reducing the number of required data points by 55% through the simplification of reporting templates and closer alignment with supervisory reporting.
